records.translation: Samla in den äldsta generation som nått sin tröskel, eller utför en uttrycklig begäran om fullständig städning.

records.context: Without an explicit cleanup request, collection is deferred during a heavy import or busy-worker deferral. Otherwise, generations are checked in order 2, 1, 0, and ``gc.collect(generation)`` is called for the first whose count exceeds its saved threshold (or its current threshold when none was saved). No collection is requested when none is due.
records.label: spacr.qt.gc_policy.collect_once#1
records.source: Without an explicit cleanup request, collection is deferred during a heavy import or busy-worker deferral. Otherwise, generations are checked in order 2, 1, 0, and ``gc.collect(generation)`` is called for the first whose count exceeds its saved threshold (or its current threshold when none was saved). No collection is requested when none is due.
records.translation: Utan en uttrycklig städningsbegäran skjuts insamlingen upp under en tung import eller när insamlingen är uppskjuten på grund av upptagna arbetstrådar. Annars kontrolleras generationerna i ordningen 2, 1, 0 och ``gc.collect(generation)`` anropas för den första vars räknare överstiger dess sparade tröskel (eller dess aktuella tröskel om ingen har sparats). Ingen insamling begärs när ingen generation nått sin tröskel.

records.source: Select a regex for a set of filenames.

records.context: 1. Try every :data:`BUILTIN_REGEXES` pattern; if one matches every file it wins immediately. 2. Otherwise pick the built-in that matches the MOST files (>=50 %). 3. Below 50 % coverage, try ``spacr.regex_infer.propose`` and return the first proposal with recognised metadata groups and more matches than the best built-in. 4. Otherwise try ``_synthesise_regex``. Keep the best built-in if synthesis fails, cannot compile, or matches fewer files. Equal match counts favour the synthesised pattern.
records.label: spacr.qt.regex_detect.auto_detect_regex#2
records.source: 1. Try every :data:`BUILTIN_REGEXES` pattern; if one matches every file it wins immediately. 2. Otherwise pick the built-in that matches the MOST files (>=50 %). 3. Below 50 % coverage, try ``spacr.regex_infer.propose`` and return the first proposal with recognised metadata groups and more matches than the best built-in. 4. Otherwise try ``_synthesise_regex``. Keep the best built-in if synthesis fails, cannot compile, or matches fewer files. Equal match counts favour the synthesised pattern.
records.translation: 1. Prova varje mönster i :data:`BUILTIN_REGEXES`; om ett matchar alla filer väljs det direkt. 2. Välj annars det inbyggda mönster som matchar FLEST filer (>=50 %). 3. Vid täckning under 50 % provas ``spacr.regex_infer.propose``, och det första förslaget med igenkända metadatagrupper och fler matchningar än det bästa inbyggda mönstret returneras. 4. Prova annars ``_synthesise_regex``. Behåll det bästa inbyggda mönstret om syntesen misslyckas, inte kan kompileras eller matchar färre filer. Vid lika många matchningar väljs det syntetiserade mönstret.

records.context: Chart ``spec``'s control value plate by plate over run order.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.control_chart.control_chart#0
records.source: Chart ``spec``'s control value plate by plate over run order.
records.translation: Rita kontrollvärdet i ``spec`` platta för platta i körningsordning.

records.context: The whole policy is in the module docstring; the short version is that one point is drawn per laboratory microplate in processing-session order, sigma comes from the selected estimator, the limits are estimated from a stated baseline and applied forward, and every rule that fires is reported by number, in words, and with the laboratory microplates it fired on. Automatic estimator selection uses within-laboratory microplate subgroup variation when a laboratory microplate has multiple control microplate sample positions, and moving ranges otherwise.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.control_chart.control_chart#1
records.source: The whole policy is in the module docstring; the short version is that one point is drawn per plate in run order, sigma comes from the selected estimator, the limits are estimated from a stated baseline and applied forward, and every rule that fires is reported by number, in words, and with the plates it fired on. Automatic estimator selection uses within-plate subgroup variation when a plate has multiple control wells, and moving ranges otherwise.
records.translation: Hela policyn finns i modulens dokumentationssträng; kortfattat ritas en punkt per platta i körningsordning, sigma kommer från den valda skattningsmetoden, gränserna skattas från en angiven baslinje och tillämpas framåt, och varje utlöst regel rapporteras med nummer, i ord och med de plattor där den utlöstes. Det automatiska valet av skattningsmetod använder variation inom plattans undergrupp när en platta har flera kontrollbrunnar, annars glidande variationsvidder.
